gates.name: comments-python
gates.run: n=$(git diff -U0 "origin/${FLEET_BASE_REF:-main}...HEAD" -- '*.py' bin/check | grep -E '^\+[[:space:]]*#' | grep -vE '^\+[[:space:]]*#(!|[[:space:]]*(type:|noqa|pragma))' | tee /dev/stderr | wc -l); [ "$n" -le 3 ]

gates.name: change-size
gates.run: n=$(git diff --numstat "origin/${FLEET_BASE_REF:-main}...HEAD" | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'); echo "added: $n"; [ "$n" -le 999 ]
